capabilities: Decorate text matching note titles or aliases as virtual links in edit and read mode
Convert virtual links to real links via context menu or command
Include or exclude match targets by folder, tag, or file
Configure matching by case sensitivity, whole-word or part-word mode, and duplicate suppression
Show matching occurrences for open notes in a Highlights sidebar panel
disambiguation: Not a URL autolinker; it links existing text to notes in the vault by title or alias match.
extras: Recommended install path is via BRAT as a beta plugin; version 3.1.3+ requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or newer (3.1.2 supports 1.5.0). README includes a privacy section explaining vault enumeration via vault.getMarkdownFiles() and states all matching runs locally.
intentEvidence: This project was originally forked from Obsidian Virtual Linker by Valentin Schröter
problem: Obsidian only connects notes through manually written real links, so mentions of existing note titles stay unlinked until the author links them by hand.

relations.evidence: originally forked from Obsidian Virtual Linker by Valentin Schröter, now maintained independently

summary: Virtual link generator that decorates text matching other notes' titles or aliases with clickable links, without changing the note text.
